label: Rainfall (CHIRPS v3)
source: CHIRPS v3.0 monthly (Climate Hazards Center, UCSB)
aggregation: area-weighted mean of 0.05° cells (cell coverage fraction x cos lat)
notes: Coverage 2018-01..2025-12. Satellite IR + station blend with gauge-undercatch correction (v3 is wetter than v2). Cross-validated against IMERG precip_mm and TerraClimate tc_ppt: see docs/VALIDATION_rainfall.md. Ratio to 2018 is meaningless in dry-season months near 0 mm; compare wet-season or annual totals.
